title: Linear area formula in integral form (step 7)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L : ℝ^n → ℝ^P an injective (continuous) linear map, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ an arbitrary function. Then ∫_{L(ℝ^n)} f dH^n = √det(L* ∘ L) · ∫_{ℝ^n} f(Lb) dL^n(b). Here L(ℝ^n) is the range submodule of L viewed as a set, L* is the adjoint, H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, and L^n is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n. Both integrals are Bochner integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Injective L → ∫ y in (LinearMap.range (L : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n] = Real.sqrt ((L.adjoint ∘L L).det) * ∫ b, f (L b)
